# Scroll Craft Skill

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor: Builds premium scroll-driven landing pages for service, product, food and drink brands, with dimensional heroes, a feeling curve, one engineered peak and one signature move. It plans the visitor journey first, then builds one real HTML page and verifies it by scrolling every position on desktop, mobile and reduced motion.

The skill starts with an eight-question interview that fixes the brief, the feeling curve and the one moment to remember, then picks one of eight page grammars and invents one bespoke signature move. A fingerprint gate forces each new build to differ from every earlier one on at least four of six dimensions, and the page is verified by scrolling it at desktop, mobile and reduced-motion settings. It ships with 11 references, 7 scripts and its own engine, scrollcraft.js and scrollcraft.css, copied into each build and never edited per project. Generating assets through kie.ai costs credits, 28 per image and 160 per five-second clip, about 520 for a six-act page, with no dollar price shown in the repo, while building from your own photos needs no key and no spend. Verification runs in headless Chrome, which cannot reproduce a real phone, so a green check does not prove the hero clip plays on an actual device. By @nateherkai, listed here with credit to its creator. Discovered via GitHub. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Asset generation via kie.ai may need paid credits.
